{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The American people understand that good health is the foundation of individual achievement and economic prosperity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Ensuring quality, affordable health care for every single American is essential to children's education, workers' productivity and businesses' competitiveness.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Covering all Americans is not just a moral imperative, but is necessary to making the health system workable and affordable.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Covering all would end cost-shifting from the uninsured.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Covering all would promote prevention and wellness.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Covering all would stop insurance discrimination.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Covering all would help eliminate health care disparities.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Covering all would achieve savings through competition, choice, innovation, and higher quality care.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There are different approaches within the Democratic Party about how best to achieve the commitment of covering every American.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party is united in its commitment to covering every American, with everyone in and no one left out.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party opposes policies that would thrust millions of Americans out of their current private employer-based coverage without providing them access to an affordable, comprehensive alternative.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Such policies would subject Americans to insurance discrimination that leads to excessive premiums or coverage denials for older and sicker Americans.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party rejects those who have steadfastly opposed insurance coverage expansions for millions of Americans while protecting overpayments to insurers and allowing underpayments to doctors.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party's vision of a strengthened and improved health care system for all Americans stands in contrast to the Republican Party's vision.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
